summary: Iter-293.4 Global Qoyod Production Write Lock — backend HTTP & in-process verification. All 10 new HTTP tests + the 55-test existing pytest suite + 2 kill-switch tests PASS (67/67 = 100%). Verified: (a) PUT /settings persists production_writes_locked true/false and rejects unknown fields (Pydantic extra='forbid'), (b) GET /admin/write-lock-report returns all required keys (ok, production_writes_locked, production_writes_locked_field, fail_closed_default_enabled, lock_source, summary.{total_blocked_24h,by_action_24h,operator_note}, items), with lock_source='explicit_setting' when the field is explicitly true OR false, (c) POST /admin/preview-reprocess works when locked AND never sets qoyod_request_sent=true (no api.qoyod.com call), (d) POST /test-connection returns 400 no_credentials (no creds configured) — confirming the lock does NOT intercept the GET probe, (e) In-process: QoyodAPIClient._request raises QoyodWriteLockedError BEFORE httpx fires (mock_request.await_count==0) for POST, while GET /products IS allowed through. State was restored to original (False) after the run.
critical_code_review_comments: write_lock.py is_locked() correctly honours explicit True/False before falling back to QOYOD_FAIL_CLOSED_DEFAULT env — semantics match the spec.
QoyodAPIClient._request enforces the lock BEFORE any httpx call (verified by mock_request.await_count==0 assertion). Defense-in-depth correctly placed at the lowest write boundary.
GET requests are correctly excluded (WRITE_METHODS = {POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE}) — test-connection (/me, GET) and list_products (GET) both pass through when locked.
Preview-reprocess does not call api.qoyod.com regardless of lock state — verified via qoyod_request_sent flag in response.
SettingsPatch uses extra='forbid' — unknown fields rejected with 422; toggle PUTs are atomic and persisted (verified by GET round-trip).

Minor: in-process write-blocked test relies on _request kwarg `json_body` (private API). If the kwarg name ever changes, this test will need a touch. Public-API equivalent (`create_invoice`) requires an `idem=` kwarg which is fine for callers but slightly less ergonomic for ad-hoc tests.
seed_data_creation: none — restored production_writes_locked to its pre-test value (False) via module-scoped fixture teardown
context_for_next_testing_agent: 10 HTTP tests in /app/backend/tests/test_qoyod_write_lock_iter293_4_http.py + 55 existing in test_qoyod_global_write_lock_iter293_4.py + 2 kill-switch tests all pass (67 total). The HTTP test uses /app/frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for the public URL. The in-process tests mock httpx.AsyncClient.request to assert the lock fires BEFORE the network call. No real Qoyod API key required. The module-scope fixture restores the lock to False at teardown; if you need it locked, set it explicitly per test.
rca of the issue: Not a bug fix — verification only. Lock implementation is sound at the QoyodAPIClient._request layer (defense in depth); audit collection qoyod_write_lock_attempts captures attempts; report endpoint surfaces 24h stats correctly; preview/test-connection are correctly NOT gated since they don't write.
